messages.content: 你能給我盧浮宮博物館未來3個月的展覽資訊嗎？然後告訴我巴黎地區最好的意式和中式餐廳嗎？

function.name: restaurant_info
function.description: Get restaurant information for a specific area. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: Location for which to find restaurants.

food_type.description: Type of cuisine for which to find restaurants. Default is 'all' if not specified.

function.name: exhibition_info
function.description: Get exhibition information for a specific museum. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

museum_name.description: Name of the museum for which to find exhibitions.

month.description: Number of upcoming months for which to retrieve exhibition details. Default is 1 if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user wants two things:

1. Exhibition info for Louvre Museum for next 3 months. Use function exhibition_info with museum_name="Louvre Museum", month=3.

2. Restaurant info for Paris region for Italian and Chinese cuisines. Use function restaurant_info twice: location="Paris", food_type="Italian" and location="Paris", food_type="Chinese".

We need to call the functions accordingly. The user asked for both. We should do them sequentially. Probably we can combine calls? The system says we can only call one function at a time. So we will call exhibition_info first, then restaurant_info twice. But we might want to combine the restaurant calls into one? The function signature allows specifying food_type but only one type per call. So we need two calls.

Thus we will produce three function calls. According to guidelines, we should output each function call separately. The assistant should respond with the function calls. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we proceed.

We need to use the correct JSON format. For exhibition_info: { "museum_name": "Louvre Museum", "month": 3 }.

For restaurant_info: { "location": "Paris", "food_type": "Italian" } and { "location": "Paris", "food_type": "Chinese" }.

We should output them as separate messages. The system says we can only call one function at a time. So we need to send the first function call, wait for response, then second, etc. But the user asked for both. We can do them sequentially. We'll start with exhibition_info. Then after receiving result, we can call restaurant_info twice. But we can't do all at once. So we will first call exhibition_info.
